home.heroTitleLine1: I don't follow just one path.
home.heroBio: Technology, hospitality and entrepreneurship are different languages I use to build the same thing: experiences, connections and projects that leave a mark.
home.identityText: My path is not a straight line. It is where technical precision meets care for people, digital systems meet hospitality, and wine culture meets the desire to build something new.
home.techTitle: Designing what does not exist yet.
home.techText: Computer Engineering, Applied Computer Science and digital projects: technology as a way to shape ideas and make them scalable.
home.hospitalityText: Luxury hospitality, wine and mixology: expertise, presence and attention to detail create relationships people remember.
home.bridgeText: This is where both paths become enterprise: digital products with a human dimension, hospitality projects supported by technology, and bridges between different cultures.
home.projectsTitle: Ideas turned into places, networks and possibilities.
home.nowText: I study, work and build at the same time. I do not wait for one path to end before beginning another.
home.nowRole: Bar Commis — Hotel de Russie, Rocco Forte Hotels
home.nowStudy: Food & Beverage Management and Computer Engineering
home.nowBuild: Mezchila, Enotempo and the FENAM ecosystem
home.nowExplore: The intersection of technology, culture and hospitality

tracks.baseIntro: Scientific high school, music and languages: meaningful foundations, kept concise so they do not overshadow what came next.
tracks.pathsIntro: Technology and hospitality are not separate chapters. They grow in parallel, influence each other and move closer together as the journey evolves.
tracks.crossIntro: Mezchila, FENAM and Enotempo are the meeting point: technology and hospitality culture working together to build a bridge between Italy and Latin America. This is where the two tracks become a single project.
